propositions: Container tickets inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact into their own dependency set, enabling scoped invalidation instead of whole-HEAD fallback
Poison rule prevents inheritance when any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, preserving fail-closed semantics and falling back to whole-HEAD invalidation
Closed children neither contribute files to the union nor poison the inheritance check, since their work is delivered and not re-litigated
Child editing its file_impact or direct child addition/removal invalidates the container attestation via material fingerprint pin drift, forcing re-review that recomputes the inherited union
P9 (file_impact_coverage) emits an advisory naming offending children when a container's inheritance is poisoned, without blocking the attestation
